# Security policy

portscan probes networks and runs a dashboard that starts scans, so security
reports are taken seriously.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Report it privately through
[GitHub's private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/KrisPowers/portscan/security/advisories/new).
Please don't open a public issue. Include what's affected, how to reproduce it,
and its impact. You'll get a reply within a week.

## Supported versions

Fixes go into the latest release and the `latest` image only.
